question: According to Census of India, 2011 Which of the following is in the top three states with highest population of age 0-6 years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra** is among the top three states with the highest population of children in the 0-6 years age group, owing to its large overall population.
 
• The population of children aged 0-6 years is an important demographic indicator reflecting birth rates and the population composition of states.
 
• In 2011, the **Census of India** recorded the distribution of this age group across all states.
 
• **Top Three States (0-6 Age Group Population)**
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:**
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh, the most populous state in India, recorded the highest population of children aged 0-6 years.
 
• This is due to high fertility rates and the state's overall large population base.
 
 
 
• **Bihar:**
 
 
• Bihar ranked second, owing to its high fertility rate and a significant percentage of young people in its population structure.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra:**
 
 
• Maharashtra ranked third due to its large population size, even though the fertility rate is relatively lower compared to Uttar Pradesh and Bihar.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__Census 2011__

 
• The Indian Census is the most credible source of information on Demography (Population characteristics), Economic Activity, Literacy and Education, Housing Household Amenities, Urbanisation, Fertility and Mortality, etc. 
 
• Census 2011 was the 15th National Census of the Country.
 
• Census was introduced in India during the era of Lord Mayo in the year 1872. It came into force in 1881.
 
• This census was conducted under the guidance of Mr. C. Chandramouli.
 
• The slogan of census 2011 was ‘Our Census, Our future’.
